details:
How It Works

Beyond Voyager is a pixel-art space mission design game built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Players start in a custom mission builder to configure spacecraft parameters, select hazard levels, and map flight routes extending from our solar system beyond the galaxy. During flight, they dodge space debris, collect telemetry data orbs, and unlock real-world NASA facts.

Benefits & Intended Impact

Space mission engineering involves complex trade-offs that often stay abstract for students. Beyond Voyager turns those concepts into a hands-on simulation—teaching players about real NASA constraints like signal light-delays, computer memory limits, and deep-space history to spark STEM curiosity.

Tools & Development

Developed from scratch using separate HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files, the game utilizes custom rendering loops and clean modular architecture. Hosted via GitHub Pages, it runs instantly in any web browser with zero downloads required.

Creativity & Design Factors

Beyond Voyager pairs retro pixel-art visuals with authentic aerospace science, weaving educational milestones directly into fast-paced gameplay. Accessibility and cross-device performance were prioritized so anyone can launch and test a mission in seconds.
